description: Override contract: column overrides to defined types over basic kinds (Label string, Count int64, Ratio float64, Flag bool, Blob []byte) and json.RawMessage on a text column, json.Number on IPv4 and Nullable(IPv4), netip.Addr on IPv4, nullable columns read and written as pointers, and a SQL type override on String reaching an Array(String) column's elements; seeded rows are read back and found by each value as a parameter, and rows written by exec, a batch of lone placeholders and a batch of rows are found and listed. Every overridden column reads through sglScanOverride. Writes bind through the value helper. Rows are listed without the json.Number columns, which encoding/json cannot marshal as numbers; the written addresses are found by value instead. A SQL type override on Int64 and the one on String also reach a named Tuple's fields, which this driver reads as a map[string]any, and a Map(String, Int64)'s keys and values, which read through sglScanOverride.
